output.question: What guidance did Nike give for the current quarter on its most recent earnings call, and how did the stock react?
output.answer: On its most recent earnings call, October 1, 2026, Nike did not give a complete standalone forecast for the current fiscal second quarter; instead, it warned of approximately 400 basis points of revenue headwinds from comparisons with prior-year EMEA promotions and North American wholesale shipments. ([investors.nike.com](https://investors.nike.com/news-events/press-releases/detail/575/nike-inc-reports-fiscal-2027-first-quarter-results)) Management said those comparisons would pressure second-quarter revenue growth relative to the first quarter. ([investors.nike.com](https://investors.nike.com/financial-information/financial-results/transcript/9591/q1-2027-transcript)) Its broader fiscal 2027 guidance called for revenue to decline by high single digits and adjusted earnings per share of $1.15–$1.35, as issued October 1. ([investors.nike.com](https://investors.nike.com/news-events/press-releases/detail/575/nike-inc-reports-fiscal-2027-first-quarter-results)) Nike shares fell following the results and outlook, finishing the next trading session, October 2, down 3.6%. ([apnews.com](https://apnews.com/article/stocks-markets-bonds-us-oil-a2b99562febc21d84955e243c87f5d31))

key_facts.fact: Nike's latest reported earnings call was its fiscal 2027 first-quarter call on October 1, 2026.

As of the October 1 call, Nike did not provide complete standalone second-quarter guidance. It identified approximately 400 basis points of second-quarter revenue headwinds from prior-year EMEA promotional activity and North American sell-in comparisons, and warned of sequential pressure on revenue growth rates.
Nike's October 1 fiscal 2027 outlook projected a high-single-digit revenue decline and adjusted diluted EPS of $1.15–$1.35.
Nike stock declined 3.6% in the October 2, 2026 trading session following its earnings release and call.

passages.quote: NIKE, Inc. management will host a conference call beginning at approximately 2:00 p.m. PT on October 1, 2026
These 2 items will represent a headwind of approximately 400 basis points to revenues in the second quarter.
Such gains more than made up for a 3.6% drop for Nike.

caveats: The approximately 400-basis-point headwind was not a forecast that total quarterly revenue would decline 4%; it described the effect of two comparison factors.
The fiscal 2027 EPS range is full-year guidance, not second-quarter guidance, and excludes approximately $0.15 per share of restructuring expenses.
The stock reaction cited is the next regular trading session's decline, not an after-hours move or a change attributable solely to the earnings call.
The opened Associated Press page did not display a publication date; its October 2, 2026 date was supplied by the search result metadata.
